ambulance_cover.limit_text: Rs 2,000 (SI 3L) up to Rs 3,000 (SI 5L-10L) per hospitalization.

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to 100% of Sum Insured for treatment at home exceeding 3 consecutive days.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Alternative treatments (Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) up to 25% of Sum Insured.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: 100% automatic recharge of base SI once per policy year, for unrelated illness/injury.

room_rent_capping: Up to 1% of SI per day; single private room category.
icu_capping: Up to 2% of SI per day (no limit on highest SI tier).
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-payment if entry age <=70 years; 30% co-payment if entry age >70 years.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Rs 20,000 per eye (SI 3L) up to Rs 30,000 per eye (SI 5L-10L)
disease_wise_sub_limits.total_knee_replacement: Rs 80,000 (SI 3L) up to Rs 1,20,000 per knee (SI 10L)

available_riders: Active Health Check-up Thrice a Year

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual cardiac health check-up cashless at network providers.
